sourceType.description: What kind of record it cites, e.g. `transcript_entry`.

sourceId.description: The record it cites. `sourceType` says what kind.

confidence.description: How sure a model was. Absent for rules and people. For display and review only; nothing in the lifecycle reads it.

metadata.description:
Context from other domains, by the cross-domain pass-through
convention — `intake.interviewId`, say — so everything proposed
during something can be listed together.

expiresAt.description: When it stops applying, if nothing decides it first. One day after it was proposed, when not given.

subjectType.description: What kind of record it is about, e.g. `application_member`.

subjectId.description: The record it is about. `subjectType` says what kind.

path.description: The field within the record it is about, as a JSON Pointer — `/income`. Absent, it is about the whole record.

category.description:
What kind of thing it points out — an entry of the
`suggestion-categories` registry, which a contract set declares.
Its description is what a person reads when there is no message.
Absent, it is uncategorized: something no category covers yet,
found with `q=kind:informing -category:*`.

message.description: What it points out, in words of its own — a model's, about this conversation. Required when there is no category.
